items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: when you were studying with Slossberg

ctx.x: One moment. Now, when you were studying with Slossberg, did he ever give you -- now, what kind of musician was he, was he like a classical --
Oh, Slossberg, he was (Inaudible) he was a virtuoso on the trumpet. And I knew I needed this. I always knew I needed that.
But what did he play? Did you talk to him about what he thought of people like Louis Armstrong?
